about: A pharmacy's dispensing label for a strip sold from a box — the medicine's name and strength, its route and the dose typed on the basket line, and the strip's batch and expiry. Printed from the basket line, {uom} is the line's unit (Strip). custom_strength and custom_route are the shop's own Data fields on Item; Dose is an active Transaction Item Attribute.

payload.template:
{item_name} {item.custom_strength}
{item.custom_route} · {detail.Dose}
{uom} · Batch {batch_no} · Exp {expiry_date}
{store}
